mu_lnA.note: population median amplitude; 95% prior range ~0.7-35 km/s, broad enough to include amplitudes reported as upper limits by Chase et al. 2025 (~20 km/s) and Oman & Riley 2024 (<10 km/s, Milky Way). A choice, not a measurement.

sigma_lnA.note: galaxy-to-galaxy spread of ln A; regularisation choice

mu_u.note: population position of ln l between each galaxy's bounds

phi.note: decomposition variant only: correlated fraction of published variance

beta.kind: computational support; keeps low-g slope 1-beta in [0, 0.95]

sigma_int.kind: proposal: half-normal including zero; scale is a regularisation choice

tau.kind: proposal: half-normal including zero; scale is a regularisation choice

inclination.kind: physical: proposal (Gaussian, catalogue errors); bounds 0<i<=90 as in Li et al. 2018

upsilon_disk.kind: physical: proposal (log-normal about SPARC value 0.5); 0.1 dex width as in Li et al. 2018, Sec. 2.2

upsilon_bulge.kind: physical: as above; only galaxies with Vbul > 0 get this parameter
